title.narrative: Capacity strengthening initiative for local, national NGOs and Community Based Organizations in South Sudan

description.narrative: Capacity strengthening among local partners, C4C and non C4C Endorsers in South Sudan is commonly focused on learning events that improve the technical skills in certain thematic focus areas. Conversations among the national, local and community-based organizations indicate the need for a focused and long-term organizational capacity strengthening and development approach beyond technical programmatic competencies alone. Lack of overhead costs in their partnerships also give chance to staff retention challenges to maintain key technical staff, hence reducing their ability to attract them again. This third phase of the capacity initiative will target new and diverse C4C Endorsers with capacity strengthening activities that will include financial management (QuickBooks), Human Resources and Procurement management training, governance and leadership followed by coaching of the former benefited C4C Endorsers Problem Statement Several key informants from local actors noted that majority of capacity building and strengthening activities have been focusing on one-off technical skills training. In contrast, long-term mentoring, coaching and a focus on institutional capacity strengthening for NNGOs sustainability is needed to advance the localization agenda. Limited institutional capacity to absorb funding is recognized as a critical challenge. A significant number of local and national actors face weak operational capacity and lack of internal controls. This key challenge makes it difficult for local actors to provide the level of financial accountability required by international donors Project Justification Local and national NGOs play a key role in reaching people in need of humanitarian assistance and their central role as articulated in the Grand Bargain has become more apparent as they can more readily access affected communities. National NGOs have the advantage of closely observing and understanding the needs of the affected communities and tailoring generic interventions to better match the needs. They communicate in the local languages and there is a commensurate level of trust, which comes from this interaction. Such advantages situate them in an advantageous position to provide relevant and contextualized services these communities need in contradiction to the internationally led, at times socio-culturally out of step, humanitarian assistance. Project Goal and Objectives To enhance organizational capacity of local and national NGOs C4C Endorsers in South Sudan Objectives To identify and address C4C Endorsers organizational priority needs for immediate capacity-strengthening interventions by the end of the project period. To design and implement specific capacity strengthening needs for selected C4C Endorsers Fund Commitment DCA $21,613 CA $25,200
